pages.title: Born in Chaos
pages.text: $(bold)What Born in Chaos's night creatures leave: dark metal and its blades, the bonescaller's staff, charms, elixirs and bombs, monster flesh and skin, the sweets of the pumpkin folk, and the scorched wood and black argillite of their haunts.$(br2)$(thing)Gilded Age$(n), ring 5.$(br)$(thing)18 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Hunter.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill 20 dread hounds, decrepit skeletons, bruisers or bonescallers$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
